content:
Overview

Annapolis is a city in MD with a population of 40,000. Maryland’s capital on the Chesapeake Bay with the Naval Academy and historic sailing heritage. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
